official_immigration_source_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Belarus — Visa-free travel (general information)
review_notes: Bangladesh ordinary passport is not on the MFA ordinary-passport visa-free list, the 68-country eVisa list, or the separate airport visa-free list. A visa is required. Tourist Type C visas may be single/double entry and no longer than 30 days. A Belarusian tourist-company, sanatorium/resort or agritourism visa-support letter is the standard supporting document; the consular officer may waive it for qualifying nationalities, but Bangladesh's migration-threat classification is not established here. Standard processing is 5 working days, urgent processing 2 working days; standard consular fee EUR 60. A conditional airport-issued tourist visa is possible: an inviter must submit the original invitation and copy to Minsk National Airport's Division for Admission of Foreigners at least 2 business days before arrival, and the stamped copy is required for airline check-in. Tourist/private applications may also be filed through Centrkurort at least 4 business days before arrival. This is not a walk-up VOA; flights from Russia cannot use the airport visa route.

official_immigration_source_name: MRE Paraguay — Consulate General in Buenos Aires: Visas
review_notes: Bangladesh ordinary passports require a visa and are not on Paraguay's official visa-exempt list. The Embassy of Paraguay in New Delhi is concurrently accredited to Bangladesh. Standard consular route: complete the online non-resident tourist application, select the nearest competent mission (New Delhi), attend any required interview and apply at least 30 days before travel. The MRE Buenos Aires page lists Bangladesh among nationalities requiring prior MFA authorization and estimates about one month; its USD65 single/USD100 multiple fee is mission-specific and must not be assumed for New Delhi. Standard walk-up VOA list excludes Bangladesh. An exceptional airport visa may be requested only when justified circumstances prevent or reasonably hinder normal consular processing, with a Paraguay-based inviter, online application, formal invitation and prior MRE resolution; absence of a local mission alone is not sufficient. File at least 30 days before arrival. The visa is stamped at Silvio Pettirossi Airport after approval and fee payment. Regulation 1384/12 states multiple entry and validity up to 90 days; permitted stay and exceptional airport fee are not stated in the current MRE page.

review_notes: BOCA's designated-country procedure, published 17 July 2026, explicitly lists Bangladesh. Visitor visas for designated-country nationals are limited to official missions; religious, athletic or cultural exchange; visits to dependents with legal residence; economic/commercial business; crew duty; or medical treatment. Tourism is not among the permitted purposes, so there is no standard tourist visitor-visa application route for Bangladeshi ordinary passport holders. Bangladesh is not on the current visa-exempt list. The generic tourism checklist applies only subject to this designated-country restriction; do not treat it as a tourist route for Bangladesh.
